scope.time: real local H.264 codecs; link, feedback and playout timestamps are virtual
scope.controller: same v29 wire-load policy and recovery configuration; closed-loop actions may differ because the encoded bytes change
scope.link: unchanged FIFO link, admission, serialization and age-drop semantics; no sender pacer or queue eviction
scope.vbv: nominal duration rounded up to integer kbits and at least one nominal source frame; a codec buffer setting is not a guaranteed per-frame or wire-rate cap
scope.paired_link: same parameters/seed; different admissions may shift random draws; zero jitter/random loss is the cleaner comparison
scope.limits: bounded synthetic scene, ideal reliable reverse feedback, no physical display, network transport, Colab allocation or production congestion-control claim
